upstream: preserve all eight corpus record identifiers in needs
downstream: emit one priority for each of the eight needs
set recommendation.top_need to the highest-demand need lacking direct capability coverage
set recommendation.decision to prioritize when that top need lacks direct capability coverage, otherwise maintain
functional_stages: upstream_demand_selection: select rows with (demand_score >= 3) OR record_id in the explicit fallback list [n06-r07,n06-r08]; inside this boundary iterate the selected rows, append a Python dictionary literal containing record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight to a records list, and return a DataFrame built from that list (a DataFrame column slice alone does not satisfy this record-construction requirement); the OR fallback must remain in the returned data path

upstream_evidence_normalization: define the explicit index-window list [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7] and the explicit allowed-record-id list [n06-r01,n06-r02,n06-r03,n06-r04,n06-r05,n06-r06,n06-r07,n06-r08]; reindex to the five required columns so an absent record field becomes a neutral JSON-safe sentinel (empty string for identifiers/text or 0 for numbers), filter by membership of each existing record_id in the allowed list without assigning or reconstructing identifiers, then use the window length as a safe upper bound (for example head(len(index_window))) to retain however many rows remain without an out-of-bounds error

upstream_provenance_assembly: consume record fields with missing-safe access, use Python sorted with (-demand_score, record_id) as the ordering key, assign the resulting one-based rank, and construct evidence-source records including record_id, source_id, source_weight, and rank; an absent source field must remain a neutral JSON-safe sentinel rather than causing an exception or being reconstructed

downstream_coverage_mapping: define the explicit allowed-record-id list [n06-r01,n06-r02,n06-r03,n06-r04,n06-r05,n06-r06,n06-r07,n06-r08], consume handoff fields with missing-safe access, retain handoff rows by membership of each existing record_id in that list without assigning or reconstructing identifiers, and construct coverage records with literal record_id, need, capability_id, and coverage fields while tolerating a missing capability or neutral missing-field sentinel

downstream_prioritization: consume evidence_sources and build a missing-safe record_id-to-rank map, use an explicit comparison to identify unsupported needs, and use Python sorted to rank unsupported needs ahead of covered needs with upstream provenance rank as the primary ordering key within each group

downstream_synthesis: use an explicit eight-item index-window list to retain priorities, take the first already-ranked priority record directly, and construct the recommendation as a literal dictionary with top_need and decision fields from that record; do not re-filter, re-sort, or recompute unsupported status in synthesis because prioritization is the sole ranking stage
